'''Theol Dunoche''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. He was a charming [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends#Civilian use|captain]] and [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]]. A 6,500-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was issued for him because he kidnapped two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girls and stole 25 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. In reality, he saved the girls from being sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] and escaped with them to [[Adner]].
